# Vasyl Mosiiuk

> Senior Software Engineer at UiPath, Lviv, Ukraine. Senior software engineer with 12+ years in .NET, including 6 years at UiPath building automation and process-discovery products end to end: Windows capture engines and desktop data pipelines, multi-tenant ASP.NET Core services on Azure, on-premises Kubernetes releases and, since 2026, AI agents in TypeScript and Python. Known for re-architecting unstable components, owning security and release work, and unblocking cross-team releases.

Contact: vasyl.mosiiuk@gmail.com. Languages: Ukrainian (Native), English (Upper-intermediate, B2).
